annotation.title_clean: Liability for artificial intelligence and other emerging digital technologies
annotation.title_en: Liability for artificial intelligence and other emerging digital technologies
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Directorate-General for Justice and Consumers (European Commission), Expert Group on Liability and New Technologies
annotation.summary_en: EU Expert Group report (2019) on liability for AI and emerging digital technologies. It finds that Member State liability regimes give victims basic protection. Complexity, self-learning, limited predictability and cybersecurity vulnerabilities may make compensation harder, so EU and national liability regimes need adjusting. Only producer liability is harmonised, by the Product Liability Directive.
key_provisions_or_claims: Existing Member State liability regimes ensure at least basic victim protection.
Complexity, updates, self-learning, limited predictability and cyber vulnerability may hinder compensation claims.
Only strict producer liability is harmonised at EU level, by the Product Liability Directive.
Allocation of liability may be unfair or inefficient for emerging digital technologies.
EU and national liability regimes need certain adjustments.
